subject: pe
title: Muscles & Bones: Joints in Action
welcome_lead: Joints let the body move — and there are several types.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: hinge, ball-and-socket, pivot joints.
final_note: Each joint type is shaped for a different job.

concepts.def: Joint that moves one way — like knee.
Joint moving many ways — like shoulder.
Tough band joining bone to bone.

walkthroughs.body_html: The knee and elbow are hinge joints. They bend and straighten in one plane.
The shoulder and hip are ball-and-socket joints — moving in many directions.
Tendons attach muscle to bone. Ligaments hold bone to bone, keeping joints stable.
